access_notes: All endpoints below are public (no API key) unless noted. Authenticated endpoints require API keys (see API Keys doc). Demo environment available for testing without real funds.
collection_policy: Collect ALL open markets via paginated GET /markets, persist raw responses with run metadata, then filter client-side for politics/elections. Never invent prices. Every snapshot file records source endpoint, fetch timestamp, and record counts.

events.note: NOT directly verified this session (docs page not fetched). Client tries it and degrades gracefully; all behavior is logged.

get_markets.note: Public endpoint recommended by Kalshi docs for first request. Paginated via cursor.
get_markets.params_note: limit/cursor confirmed in docs examples. Any additional server-side filters (status/series/event) are NOT assumed; filtering is done client-side on verified response fields (status, ticker, event_ticker, title, subtitle).

legal_status.election_contracts_note: Kalshi lists election outcome contracts following federal court decisions in KalshiEX LLC v. CFTC (2024). Election markets observed live on kalshi.com on 2026-09-18 (Midterms Hub). Full current docket status NOT re-verified this session.

politics_filter_strategy.method: Client-side keyword heuristics over verified fields (event_ticker, title, subtitle) PLUS optional operator-maintained series allowlist. Every match records which rule fired so the filter is auditable. Category-taxonomy filtering will be added once live API responses confirm the exact category fields.
politics_filter_strategy.series_allowlist_config: data/kalshi_series_allowlist.json (operator maintained; empty until confirmed from live API)

verification.method: direct page fetch of docs.kalshi.com pages + kalshi.com homepage; search-result corroboration for legal status
